{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify the six QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
df_qa = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Check how many QA orders there are
num_qa = len(df_qa)

# Remove QA orders from the dataset for analysis
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99']

# Count completed orders in the cleaned data
completed_clean = df_clean['status'].value_counts().get('completed', 0)

# Print the results
num_qa, completed_clean"}
